blocks.arabic_text: الْمَسْجِدِ اْلأَيْسَرِ لِقِلَّةِ أَهْلِهِ فَلَهُ أَجْرَانَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير، وفيه: بقية وهو مدلس وقد عنعنه ولكنه ثقة مجمع الزوائد:٢ /٢٥٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Since few people stand on the left side of the row, the person who fills the left side of the row will receive two rewards.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- When the Sahabah came to know that there is more reward in standing on the right side than in standing on the left side, everyone wished to stand on the right side. Because of this, the left side began to be left empty. So that the left side would not remain empty, the Prophet ﷺ also spoke about the excellence of standing on the left side.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ﵂ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ اللهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَي الَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ الصُّفُوفَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقال: هذا حديث صحيح علي شرط مسلم ولم يخرجاه ووافقه الذاهبي:٢١٤/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Aishah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Allah showers mercy on those who fill the empty places in the rows, and the angels make du'a for their forgiveness.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: لَايَصِلُ عَبْدٌ صَفّاً إِلَّارَفَعَهُ اللهُ بِهِ دَرَجَةً، وَذَرَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنَ الْبِرِّ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو بعض الحديث) رواه الطبراني في الاوسط ولاباس باسناده الترغيب:٣٢٢/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Because a person joins up an empty place in a row, Allah raises him by one rank, and the angels scatter mercies upon him.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: خِيَارُكُمْ
